message: The other day, I was rummaging through my closet and stumbled upon my emergency kit. Now, I know what you're thinking — who has an emergency kit just sitting there? Well, I do! It’s like my little trophy for being gloriously over-prepared. I even found a flashlight that I forgot I had. It’s almost a party trick at this point! But hey, if the power goes out during a storm, I’ll be the one with snacks and a light show. Just a gentle reminder that a bit of prep can turn a stormy day into a cozy adventure. 🕯️
